description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE K (id LONG, k TEXT(20)); Close; DBEngine.SetOption(dbImplicitCommitSync, "Yes"); OpenDatabase shared read/write. K(id LONG, k TEXT(20)) with CREATE INDEX IX_K ON K (k); 410 keys abcd0002, abcd0004, ..., abcd0820 (even numbers) inserted ascending, so the full root splits (r-q7 text-split: 401 entries under stored prefix 6) and leaves a full left leaf; then abcd0401, a key inside that leaf. Pages 44-59 are read whole after the 400th, 401st, 402nd and 410th key and after abcd0401, and the first 28 bytes of pages 44-63 after every insert from the 395th. Asks how a full leaf of an odd entry count is halved.
retentionNote: r-q19-growth-open (zfrp stretch 4 open growth cases): designed probe, one element varied; answers kept with their page bytes
